response.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0

assumptions.assumption: The 'higher side' of the 1.0 dividing line means points strictly greater than 1.0. Records with exactly 1.0 points are on the lower side and are excluded. NULL points are ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: The higher side includes the dividing line, so records with points >= 1.0 are kept.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0
